title: Mommy Worries Too
vol: Mommy Is Human Too · Book Fourteen
verse: Everyone has worries. Breathe slow, share what's heavy, and be thankful for what is good.

pages.text:
The bills were on the table, and the car had made a sound,
and Mommy's forehead wrinkled as she walked the kitchen round.

Jojo saw her rub her eyes. Pip saw her bite her lip.
And Baby Bee saw Mommy's coffee cooling, without a sip.

"Mommy, are you worried?" Jojo asked her, soft and low.
And Mommy sighed. "A little bit. I'm human too, you know."

Then Mommy went into her room and gently shut the door,
and Jojo peeked in through the crack — and saw her on the floor:

not hurt, not sad, but sitting still, with one hand on her heart,
and breathing slow and steady, the way that calm can start.

"I don't have all the answers, and I can't fix everything.
But I can breathe, and I can ask for help with what today will bring."

Then Mommy wiped her eyes and stood, her shoulders not so tight.
She opened up the door and smiled. "Now Mommy feels all right."

"What were you doing?" Pip asked. "Breathing," Mommy said.
"When grown-ups have big worries, we slow down and clear our head."

"Do grown-ups get worried?" asked Jojo. "Don't you know it all?"
"Oh, no," said Mommy, laughing. "Sometimes I feel very small.

I breathe when I am worried, and I'm thankful when I'm glad.
I name the things that help me when the day is going bad."

"Can we do it with you?" asked Pip. So all of them sat down —
Jojo, Pip, and Baby Bee, with Biscuit curled around.

Pip hoped the car would start again. Jojo hoped for Mommy's day.
And Baby Bee said, "Thank you!" loud — her favorite words to say.

The worries didn't vanish all at once, but something new
was in the house — a peace that said, "We'll work this through."

Because your Mommy worries, and she shares her worries too —
and Mommy needs to breathe sometimes… because she's human too.

items: What are you worried about right now?
What are three things you are thankful for today?
Try belly breathing: breathe in for four, out for four.
Each say three things you are thankful for at dinner.
